turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Interesting question! It seems there might be a misunderstanding. Parrots don't actually learn or use classical conditioning based on human translations. Classical conditioning is a learning process where a neutral stimulus becomes associated with an unconditioned stimulus. In reality, parrots (and animals in general) can show signs of classical conditioning without understanding human language. If you're curious about a similar concept, maybe we could explore operant conditioning instead, which involves rewards and punishments to shape behavior.
